Following the missing-value decision row and the C32949/C1527/C1544 precedent, one explicit 0402 1_5_pico_farad row was added and C1552 becomes its first reviewed preferred house identity: FH (Guangdong Fenghua Advanced Tech) 0402CG1R5C500NT, 1.5 pF, 50 V, C0G, 0402 MLCC. The Fenghua ordering code 1R5 = 1.5 pF is consistent with the listed 1.5 pF; the live page specification table is the primary evidence. The live page lists no tolerance row, so the generic ID carries no tolerance suffix; the full stage should extract tolerance from the datasheet. Edits made under the capacitor family lock.
